inspection.coordinateStatus: Approximate pixel landmarks describe observations, not measured electrical values.

facts.description: One circuit section, not a complete supply circuit. An upper horizontal conducting path joins junction 1 on the left to junction 2 on the right. Short horizontal leads extend outward from both junctions and end without terminal symbols. A lower branch descends from each same junction and joins through the voltmeter. There are no crossings, switches, batteries, extra branches or polarity marks.

An outlined circle centered near (110,79) interrupts the upper wire between junction 1 and the resistor. Its left and right wire contacts meet opposite horizontal sides of the circle, near (75,79) and (146,78). A capital A sits inside the circle. No conductor line runs through the interior.

A single unfilled horizontal rectangular resistor lies to the right of A and left of junction 2, approximately x187..269 and y68..89. Upper wires meet the midpoints of its left and right sides. Capital R is below the rectangle. No zigzag, dimensions, numerical resistance, interior wire or arrow occurs inside it.

A second outlined circle centered near (185,214), to the right of the ammeter center and below the upper branch, interrupts the lower horizontal branch. The left and right lower wires meet opposite circle sides near (151,214) and (220,213). Capital V is inside. The lower branch reaches the same junctions 1 and 2, across the complete A-plus-R section; it does not attach only to the resistor contacts.

Exactly one directed arrow: a short horizontal rightward arrow above the resistor, approximately from (198,46) to (259,46). Capital I is above that arrow. It indicates current from junction 1 toward junction 2 along the upper branch. The arrow is not an extra conducting connection.

Exactly six visible labels: 1 above the left junction, 2 above the right junction, A inside the upper circle, R below the resistor, V inside the lower circle, and I above the rightward arrow. Source pixels contain no U1/U2, E, voltage-direction arrow, electric-field arrow, plus/minus, captions, equations, units, scale, numerical givens or subfigure labels.
